name: Neritic-Armillary

civilization.name: Vaerid Compact
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past acid rain regions, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
For traders, iron and titanium alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
